issued_by.notes: THE BULLHORN (Marketing). A bullhorn unit is the drop-day megaphone: one dated announcement an agent amplifies verbatim, on the record. The unit spec below is the instrument; units[] ships the real units.

relation_to_final_cut: THE FINAL CUT ships the full content.json publishing pack (caption + threads + hashtags + media); THE BULLHORN ships the single drop-day broadcast unit with the truth gate. Bullhorn is the megaphone blast, Final Cut is the campaign folder.

amplify_rules: Post body_verbatim exactly as written. Do not paraphrase, add adjectives, or change numbers.
Keep every URL intact. Keep the attribution (Cumulative Web Inc / That Boy Hi Hat).
Never append claims not present in claims[] — especially placement, stream-count, or timeline claims.
Amplify only units whose truth_gate.passed is true and which pass gate.py at amplification time.
fields: date (unit date, YYYY-MM-DD; the unit's anchor in time)
headline (max 180 chars; numbers in the headline must appear in a cited claim)
body_verbatim (40-1200 chars; the exact text an agent posts — never paraphrased, never extended)
claims[] (each: text, source, date — no claim without both)
truth_gate (checks[], passed, checked_at; produced by bullhorn/gate.py)
amplify (verbatim-amplification instructions: how to post, what not to add)
truth_gate_rules: Every claim must carry a non-empty source and a YYYY-MM-DD date.
A claim dated after the unit date FAILS unless the unit sets scheduled: true.
Hype-movement, unverified-playlist, and ungrounded-superlative phrases fail the unit (exact deny list lives in gate.py).
Any number appearing in headline, body_verbatim, or claim text must appear inside a claim that carries source + date. An unsourced number fails the unit.
gate.py exits 0 with PASS on a clean unit, non-zero with reasons on a failed one. A failed unit is a rejected unit — do not amplify it.

units.body_verbatim: BlackLansky/cwi-catalog is live on Hugging Face: the full 24-track That Boy Hi Hat catalog plus 18 Agent Deck products, as clean machine-readable JSONL. 5 files, zero guesswork — catalog.jsonl (24 track records), products.jsonl (18 product records), README.md, validate.py, .gitattributes. Public. Free. Built for LLMs and agents learning the CWI catalog from verified facts. https://huggingface.co/datasets/BlackLansky/cwi-catalog — amplify verbatim.

claims.text: The dataset BlackLansky/cwi-catalog is live and public on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/BlackLansky/cwi-catalog.
The dataset ships 5 files: catalog.jsonl with 24 track records, products.jsonl with 18 product records, plus README.md, validate.py, and .gitattributes.
That Boy Hi Hat is the alternative rap artist managed by Cumulative Web Inc, based in Frederick, MD; the catalog spans 24 tracks.
The dataset ships text and code files only — no audio files are included in the repository.

units.headline: That Boy Hi Hat's 24-track catalog is now a public machine-readable dataset on Hugging Face
